reviewKind: agent-authored semantic reassessment of previously observed outputs
independence: The reviewer has seen the original results and model identities. This is not independent human review, blind adjudication or a new held-out experiment.
target: Faithful reconstruction of the speaker's final intent with flexible readable presentation
allowed: Paraphrase, sentence merging, reordering and structured headings or lists
Equivalent words, digit/number spelling, punctuation and capitalization changes
Removal of fillers, repetitions, superseded self-repair clauses and optional greetings/thanks
Clean prose instead of a particular numbered-list syntax when the same items remain clear

fidelity.preserved: Final intended actions, recipients, values, polarity, uncertainty, conditions, required items and technical identities remain recoverable without material unsupported facts
fidelity.degraded: At least one of those material facts is wrong, missing or contradicted
fidelity.uncertain: The output is ambiguous enough that the intended action or material fact cannot be confidently recovered

organization.0: Unresolved repairs, filler/disfluency or malformed wording still needs cleanup
organization.1: Readable adequate prose, possibly with minor repetition or surface errors
organization.2: Clear concise prose or useful structure, with repairs resolved and distracting disfluency removed

ready: fidelity is preserved and organization >= 1; no mandated reference wording, numbering or greeting
silence: No output is the only faithful, ready result
reviewedOutput: Actual delivered text; raw model proposal and execution/validation outcome remain separately observable
constraints: Read the complete spoken script and delivered output; do not assign semantic ratings using CER/WER or keyword gates
State the concrete factual failure or presentation issue for every non-perfect rating
Do not change original fixture labels, raw outputs, model choices or original summaries
Scores describe this small synthetic corpus and this reviewer, not population model quality
